/// The terminal `getpass`, `input()` and `cn1console` use in a backend
/// build: the backend's console, `com.codename1.cli`. Generated only into a
/// backend build; an application has no terminal and installs none.
final class BackendTerminal extends PyTerminal {

    }

    static void install() {
        if (PyTerminal.get() == null) {
            PyTerminal.install(new BackendTerminal());
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isTerminal(int fd) {
        if (fd == 0) {
            return Console.isInputTerminal();
        }
        return fd == 2 ? Console.isErrorTerminal() : Console.isTerminal();
    }

    @Override
    public int columns() {
        return Console.width();
    }

    @Override
    public int rows() {
        return Console.height();
    }

        return Console.colorEnabled();
    }

    public int colorLevel() {
        return Console.colorLevel().ordinal();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean unicode() {
        return Console.unicode();
    }

    @Override
    public String readLine(String prompt) {
        return Console.readLine(prompt);
    }

    @Override
    public String password(String prompt) {
        try {
            return new Prompt.Text(prompt).mask('*').ask();
        } catch (Prompt.Cancelled e) {
            throw new PyTerminal.Cancelled();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean confirm(String question, int def) {
        try {
            return def < 0 ? Prompt.confirm(question) : Prompt.confirm(question, def == 1);
        } catch (Prompt.Cancelled e) {
            throw new PyTerminal.Cancelled();

    @Override
    public int select(String question, String[] choices, int def) {
        try {
            // By position, as multiSelect does, so equal labels stay apart.
            List<Integer> positions = new ArrayList<Integer>();
            for (int i = 0; i < choices.length; i++) {
                positions.add(Integer.valueOf(i));
            }
            final String[] labels = choices;
            Prompt.Select<Integer> s = new Prompt.Select<Integer>(question, positions)
                    .labeler(new Prompt.Labeler<Integer>() {
                        @Override
                        public String label(Integer item) {
                            return labels[item.intValue()];
                        }
                    });
            if (def >= 0 && def < choices.length) {
                s.defaultIndex(def);
            }
            return s.ask().intValue();
        } catch (Prompt.Cancelled e) {
            throw new PyTerminal.Cancelled();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int[] multiSelect(String question, String[] choices, int[] preselected) {
        try {
            // Answers are matched back by position, so equal labels stay apart.
            List<Integer> positions = new ArrayList<Integer>();
            for (int i = 0; i < choices.length; i++) {
                positions.add(Integer.valueOf(i));
            }
            final String[] labels = choices;
            List<Integer> chosen = new Prompt.MultiSelect<Integer>(question, positions)
                    .labeler(new Prompt.Labeler<Integer>() {
                        @Override
                        public String label(Integer item) {
                            return labels[item.intValue()];
                        }
                    })
                    .preselect(preselected).ask();
            int[] r = new int[chosen.size()];
            for (int i = 0; i < r.length; i++) {
                r[i] = chosen.get(i).intValue();
            }
            return r;
        } catch (Prompt.Cancelled e) {
            throw new PyTerminal.Cancelled();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public String style(String text, String[] styles) {
        Ansi a = Ansi.ansi();
        for (String s : styles) {
            apply(a, s);
        }
        String prefix = a.toString();
        if (prefix.length() == 0) {
            return text;
        }
        return prefix + text + Ansi.ansi().reset().toString();
    }

    /// One style word: an attribute, a color name ("red", "bright_blue"),
    /// "#rrggbb", or either color behind "on " for the background.
    private static void apply(Ansi a, String style) {
        String s = style.trim();
        boolean background = s.startsWith("on ");
        if (background) {
            s = s.substring(3).trim();
        }
        if (!background) {
            if ("bold".equals(s)) {
                a.bold();
                return;
            }
            if ("dim".equals(s) || "faint".equals(s)) {
                a.faint();
                return;
            }
            if ("italic".equals(s)) {
                a.italic();
                return;
            }
            if ("underline".equals(s)) {
                a.underline();
                return;
            }
            if ("reverse".equals(s) || "inverse".equals(s)) {
                a.inverse();
                return;
            }
            if ("strike".equals(s) || "strikethrough".equals(s)) {
                a.strikethrough();
                return;
            }
        }
        Ansi.Color c = color(s);
        if (c == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("unknown style: " + style);
        }
        if (background) {
            a.bg(c);
        } else {
            a.fg(c);
        }
    }

    private static Ansi.Color color(String s) {
        if (s.startsWith("#")) {
            return Ansi.Color.hex(s);
        }
        String[] names = {"black", "red", "green", "yellow", "blue", "magenta", "cyan", "white"};
        Ansi.Color[] plain = {Ansi.Color.BLACK, Ansi.Color.RED, Ansi.Color.GREEN, Ansi.Color.YELLOW,
            Ansi.Color.BLUE, Ansi.Color.MAGENTA, Ansi.Color.CYAN, Ansi.Color.WHITE};
        Ansi.Color[] bright = {Ansi.Color.GRAY, Ansi.Color.BRIGHT_RED, Ansi.Color.BRIGHT_GREEN,
            Ansi.Color.BRIGHT_YELLOW, Ansi.Color.BRIGHT_BLUE, Ansi.Color.BRIGHT_MAGENTA,
            Ansi.Color.BRIGHT_CYAN, Ansi.Color.BRIGHT_WHITE};
        if ("gray".equals(s) || "grey".equals(s)) {
            return Ansi.Color.GRAY;
        }
        boolean isBright = s.startsWith("bright_");
        String name = isBright ? s.substring(7) : s;
        for (int i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
            if (names[i].equals(name)) {
                return isBright ? bright[i] : plain[i];
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    public int width(String text) {
        return Console.displayWidth(text);
    }

    @Override
    public String table(String[] headers, String[][] rows, String[] align, String border) {
        Table t = new Table(headers);
        for (int i = 0; i < align.length; i++) {
            if ("right".equals(align[i])) {
                t.align(i, Table.Align.RIGHT);
            } else if ("center".equals(align[i])) {
                t.align(i, Table.Align.CENTER);
            }
        }
        if (border.length() > 0) {
            t.border(border(border));
        }
        for (String[] row : rows) {
            t.addRow((Object[]) row);
        }
        return t.render();
    }

    private static Table.Border border(String name) {
        for (Table.Border b : Table.Border.values()) {
            if (b.name().equalsIgnoreCase(name)) {
                return b;
            }
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("unknown border: " + name);
    }

    @Override
    public String tree(String[] labels, int[] depths) {
        if (labels.length == 0) {
            return "";
        }
        Tree root = new Tree(labels[0]);
        List<Tree> path = new ArrayList<Tree>();
        path.add(root);
        for (int i = 1; i < labels.length; i++) {
            int depth = Math.max(1, Math.min(depths[i], path.size()));
            Tree node = path.get(depth - 1).add(labels[i]);
            while (path.size() > depth) {
                path.remove(path.size() - 1);
            }
            path.add(node);
        }
        return root.render();
    }

    @Override
    public Progress progress(String label, long total, String unit) {
        final ProgressBar bar = new ProgressBar(label, total);
        if ("bytes".equals(unit)) {
            bar.bytes();
        } else if (unit != null) {
            bar.unit(unit);
        }
        return new Progress() {
            @Override
            public void step(long n) {
                bar.stepBy(n);
            }

            @Override
            public void total(long t) {
                bar.setTotal(t);
            }

            @Override
            public void message(String m) {
                bar.setMessage(m);
            }

            @Override
            public void close(boolean ok) {
                if (ok) {
                    bar.complete();
                } else {
                    bar.fail();
                }
                bar.close();
            }
        };
    }

    @Override
    public PyTerminal.Spinner spinner(String message) {
        final com.codename1.cli.Spinner s = com.codename1.cli.Spinner.start(message);
        return new PyTerminal.Spinner() {
            @Override
            public void message(String m) {
                s.setMessage(m);
            }

            @Override
            public void finish(String kind, String m) {
                String text = m == null ? "" : m;
                if ("succeed".equals(kind)) {
                    s.succeed(text);
                } else if ("fail".equals(kind)) {
                    s.fail(text);
                } else if ("warn".equals(kind)) {
                    s.warn(text);
                } else if ("info".equals(kind)) {
                    s.info(text);
                } else {
                    s.close();
                }
            }
        };
    }
